name: Create a token validation configuration
description: Create a token validation configuration Creates a JWT validation configuration for the zone. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config
Creates a JWT validation configuration for the zone.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Edit token validation credentials
description: Edit token validation credentials Updates the configuration's complete key set while allowing omitted fields on existing keys to retain stored values. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config/{config_id}/credentials
context:
PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config/{config_id}/credentials
Updates the configuration's complete key set while allowing omitted fields on existing keys to retain stored values. Omitted key identities are removed.
Required: zone_id (path); config_id (path) — Token Configuration ID; body (body)

name: Replace token validation credentials
description: Replace token validation credentials Replaces the configuration's complete key set. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config/{config_id}/credentials
context:
PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config/{config_id}/credentials
Replaces the configuration's complete key set. Symmetric keys must include their key material.
Required: zone_id (path); config_id (path) — Token Configuration ID; body (body)

name: Delete a token validation configuration
description: Delete a token validation configuration Deletes a JWT validation configuration from the zone. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config/{config_id}

name: Edit a token validation configuration
description: Edit a token validation configuration Updates only the supplied fields on a JWT validation configuration. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config/{config_id}

name: Get a token validation configuration
description: Get a token validation configuration Returns a JWT validation configuration by ID. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config/{config_id}

name: List token validation configurations

context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/token_validation/config

Optional: page (query) — Page number of paginated results.; per_page (query) — Maximum number of results per page.
